summary: KKR Infrastructure Conglomerate LLC filed an 8-K reporting the monthly transactional net asset value (NAV) per share for its Class U, R, D, I, S, F, G, and H shares as of April 30, 2026. This is a routine periodic pricing disclosure for a closed-end fund or non-traded REIT-type vehicle, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other event-driven corporate action is described. The filing serves as a standard NAV update for share repurchase and sale pricing purposes. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors are mentioned.
